title: Blocks and more
description: Adds more block variants and some custom blocks, which improves decorativity for Minecraft. Allowing builders to have  more blocks to use when building.
body:
# Blocks and More

Blocks and More is a mod that adds more blocks into the game and makes a better use of the current vanilla blocks. It has variants of different natural blocks, stairs and slabs (coming soon).

## Why chose B&M?

As Blocks and More are undergoing massive overhaul changes, the mod will add more blocks such as stairs, slabs and normal blocks to the game. Alongside more custom items with guis, there may be even some custom elements inspired from other mods added to the blocks and more mod. Obviously, there will be an inspiration section which shows what mods had made me inspired to make Blocks and More.

## Inspiration
Wemmbu

## Required Dependencies
- Fabric API (view [here](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)).

## Useful Links
- Github Source Code (view [here](https://github.com/LegitCirtuitz/BlocksAndMore)).

## Blocks

### Basic Blocks
- Block of Metal

### Stairs
- Red Concrete Stairs
- Orange Concrete Stairs
- Yellow Concrete Stairs
- Green Concrete Stairs
- Light Blue Concrete Stairs
- Cyan Concrete Stairs
- Blue Concrete Stairs
